risk_summary: The disclosure provides several quantitative and operational details, including credit capacity, borrowing terms, seasonality, and COVID-19 impacts, but also relies on broad boilerplate and conditional language. Key risks include demand volatility, inventory returns, estimation uncertainty, customer concentration, supply-chain disruption, and dependence on secured revolving credit availability. Overall tone is cautiously positive because operations reportedly rebounded, though liquidity and pandemic-related risks remain material.
